'''Zeta One Nine''' was a [[skimmer/Legends|skimmer]], an armed patrol craft.<ref name="JKaudio" /> It was assigned to [[Jerec (Inquisitor)|Jerec's]] [[Vengeance Battle Group]] during the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial]] [[Search for the Valley of the Jedi|invasion]] of [[Ruusan/Legends|Ruusan]].

==History==
It was part of [[Patrol 341]], with [[pilot/Legends|helmsman]] [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Forley]] and [[gunner/Legends|gunner]] [[Leeno]]. [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Aagon]] was the patrol leader and contained a [[squad/Legends|squad]] of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]]. It was escorted by two [[speeder bike/Legends|speeder bikes]].<ref name="JK">''[[Dark Forces: Jedi Knight]]''</ref>

The leader allowed his troops to abandon their position and have fun hunting the native creatures called [[bouncer]]s, but when the fun started, they were shot at by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]]. The vehicle landed to release the Stormtroopers and then went around the rocks to pin down the Rebels, but did not manage more than exploding some rocks, and killing one Rebel.<ref name="JK" /> At the end of the skirmish, both Forley and Leeno were attacked and incapacitated by the bouncers.<ref name="JK" /><ref name="JKaudio" />

By the next morning, the Rebels gathered all Imperial weapons and equipment they could find and loaded them on the skimmer, which was appropriated by [[Grif Grawley]] and his group of colonists.<ref name="JK" />

==Behind the scenes==
This vehicle appeared in the ''[[Dark Forces: Jedi Knight]]'' novella unnamed. In the [[Dark Forces: Jedi Knight (audio drama)|audio adaption]] the designation "Zeta One Nine" is heard. As such, the actual spelling could not be determined.

The skimmer is described a bit different between the two appearances. In the novella the vehicle seems to be a small open skimmer, with a helmsman sitting at the stern, and a swiveling weapon at the fore, both exposed to external dangers, and the [[bouncer]] who attacks Forley, and Leeno jumping out. In the audio drama it is described as an "armed patrol craft" and the dialogue suggests it to be an enclosed [[Tank/Legends|tank]], specifically a [[Hovertank/Legends|repulsortank]] complete with landing gear and landing procedure. When the bouncer attacks the two pilots, it has infiltrated the vehicle's [[hull/Legends|hull]].
